name: Exponential with full jitter
summary: Exponential backoff, then a uniform random delay between zero and that. Cuts the peak simultaneous retries roughly sixfold: the default worth shipping.

params.name: baseMs
params.description: The first ceiling, doubled on each subsequent attempt.

params.name: capMs
params.description: No ceiling exceeds this, however many attempts have failed.

params.name: maxAttempts
params.description: Give up after this many attempts.

notes: The expected delay is half the un-jittered ceiling, so this is more aggressive than plain exponential rather than less. It wins anyway because spreading matters more than the average.
